connector.name: MediaWiki MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server enabling AI clients to interact with any MediaWiki wiki through standard tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the desktop bundle MediaWiki-MCP-Server.mcpb. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the professionalwiki account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: CONFIG
env.description: Path to your configuration file

env.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
env.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

env.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Byte cap for content bodies (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs) returned by get-page, get-pages, parse-wikitext, and compare-pages. Oversized bodies are truncated with a trailing marker.

env.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

env.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
env.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

env.name: MCP_METRICS
env.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
env.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
env.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
env.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
env.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

env.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

env.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
env.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Type of MCP server transport

env.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

env.name: PORT
env.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport
